title: filelock: SoftFileLock stale-break restore follows a swapped-in symbolic link and hard-links a file of the user…
description: A vulnerability in filelock versions 4.1.0 through 4.2.0 allows a local user with write access to a shared lock directory without the sticky bit to create a hard link to another user's file by exploiting the restore branch of the stale lock break mechanism. This can expose file metadata and enable the attacker to cause the lock user's FileLock to truncate or modify the linked file. The issue arises due to symbolic link following behavior in os.link on CPython 3.12+ on Linux and macOS. The vulnerability requires specific conditions including a non-sticky writable directory and repeated lock acquisition by the lock user. It has a CVSS 3.1 score of 5.3 (Medium).
